title: Insurance Coverage & Claims: Standing Note on Appeal Levels Pursued, Patient Authorization and Payer Decision Periods
content:
For each payer class of **Insurance Coverage & Claims**, this note records how many appeal levels Halverson Clinical Laboratories files on its own initiative for a denial it is liable for, whether the payer class requires the patient's authorization for an appeal, and the period within which the payer decides a filed appeal.

| Payer class | Appeal levels the laboratory files on its own initiative | Payer class requires the patient's authorization for an appeal | Payer decides a filed appeal within (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 2 | No | 60 |
| Medicare Advantage Plan | 1 | No | 60 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan | 0 | No | 0 |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan | 1 | No | 30 |
| TRICARE Prime and Select | 1 | No | 60 |
| Commercial In-Network Plan | 2 | No | 60 |
| Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | 1 | Yes | 60 |

## Notes

- **Levels pursued.** Original Medicare Part B and Commercial In-Network Plan are pursued through 2 levels by the laboratory; Medicare Advantage Plan, Medicaid Managed Care Plan, TRICARE Prime and Select and Commercial Out-of-Network Plan through 1; Medicare Supplement Plan through 0, the laboratory filing no appeal of its own with that payer class.
- **Patient authorization.** Only the Commercial Out-of-Network Plan carries the patient-authorization attribute.
- **Decision period.** Medicaid Managed Care Plan decides within 30 calendar days and five payer classes within 60; Medicare Supplement Plan shows 0.
